claims.text: **Never run load tests against production without explicit approval.**

reference.statement: The shared cluster runs 3× t4g.large (6 vCPU, 24 GB RAM total). These limits apply:

imagesAndDiagrams.value:
| Test     | Max VUs | Max Duration | Max RPS | Environment      |
| -------- | ------- | ------------ | ------- | ---------------- |
| Smoke    | 1–5     | 30s          | —       | Any              |
| Baseline | ≤20     | 5 min        | —       | Stage only       |
| Stress   | ≤50     | 5 min        | 100     | Approved windows |
| Soak     | ≤10     | 30 min       | —       | Off-hours only   |

claims.text: Use environment variables for credentials — never hardcode
Clean up test data after each iteration
Set appropriate thresholds tied to SLO targets
Document the test in this README

reference.statement: When adding auth-flow or CRUD tests:
A performance regression is any measurable degradation from the established baseline that exceeds the thresholds below.

imagesAndDiagrams.value:
| Metric      | Threshold                      | Consequence            |
| ----------- | ------------------------------ | ---------------------- |
| p95 latency | >20% increase from baseline    | Blocks release         |
| p99 latency | >50% increase from baseline    | Blocks release         |
| Error rate  | >1% (any test)                 | Blocks release         |
| Throughput  | >15% decrease at same VU count | Investigation required |

claims.text: The scheduled `performance-baseline.yml` workflow runs weekday mornings against stage
Baseline metrics are stored as workflow artifacts (`k6-summary.json`) for trend comparison
After infrastructure or code changes that affect performance, re-establish the baseline and update thresholds if the change is intentional

imagesAndDiagrams.value:
| Severity     | Trigger                    | Owner    | Action                                       |
| ------------ | -------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| **P0**       | Error rate >1% in baseline | Dev team | Rollback or hotfix before next deploy        |
| **P1**       | p95 >20% degradation       | Dev team | Root-cause within sprint, fix before release |
| **P2**       | p99 >50% degradation       | Dev team | Investigate, may defer if p95 is healthy     |
| **Advisory** | Throughput decline <15%    | Dev team | Log and monitor, no action required          |

claims.text: Baseline test failures on `stage` block promotion to `main`
Stress test results inform capacity planning but do not block releases
Soak test anomalies trigger investigation but do not block releases unless memory growth exceeds 2× initial

reference.statement: Performance tests are **advisory** during the 30-day warm-up period after initial deployment. After warm-up:

claims.text: If synthetic data is insufficient, obtain written client approval before using anonymized derivatives of client data, scrub all PII/secrets, and load it into a dedicated test database instance — never production.

reference.statement: Performance tests use synthetic test data created during the test setup phase. Use a dedicated test organization/tenant when exercising authenticated or CRUD flows, and keep tests idempotent so repeated runs do not require manual cleanup.

claims.text: Use a dedicated lean environment when stress tests exceed 50 VUs, soak tests exceed 30 minutes, client-specific SLA validation requires isolation, or database-heavy/multi-service profiles risk saturating shared resources.

reference.statement: Stage is sufficient when VU count stays within shared-cluster limits, tests target only this project namespace, no other team is running concurrent performance tests, and results are compared against the project's own baseline.
External services must not receive real traffic during load tests.

imagesAndDiagrams.value:
| Dependency Type  | Strategy           |
| ---------------- | ------------------ |
| Email            | Stub / disable     |
| Payment          | Test mode only     |
| SMS              | Stub / disable     |
| Maps / Geocoding | Cache or stub      |
| AI / LLM APIs    | Deterministic mock |
| Client APIs      | Stub               |
| Auth providers   | Test accounts      |

reference.statement: The scheduled GitHub workflow runs against the `stage` environment. Manual dispatch is restricted to `dev` and `stage`; `BASE_URL` and `API_URL` must both be configured on the selected GitHub Environment, and production-like URLs are rejected before k6 starts.
